title: The Woman Who Was Already Cremated — Episode 6

characters.persona: Police sub-inspector assigned to verify Meera’s identity
Meera’s father who identified the burned body
Meera’s younger son who wants his mother restored immediately
Returned mother whose identity has been officially buried
Village records clerk who notices that Meera’s death paperwork was never properl
Meera’s teenage daughter who remembers a private detail only her mother should k

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Nobody touches the evidence table. The first person who crosses this rope leaves the verification.
lines.sfx_cue: crowd pressing against rope, police whistle
lines.spoken: Nobody touches the evidence table. The first person who crosses this rope leaves the verification.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Then remove Mohan. He is already beside her chair.
lines.spoken: Then remove Mohan. He is already beside her chair.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: I will sit with my Ma.
lines.spoken: I will sit with my Ma.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: He may sit there. He may not touch the documents.
lines.spoken: He may sit there. He may not touch the documents.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I want my death certificate placed in front of me.
lines.spoken: I want my death certificate placed in front of me.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: It is an official record, not an object for public handling.
lines.spoken: It is an official record, not an object for public handling.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Place it inside the transparent cover, Babulal.
lines.spoken: Place it inside the transparent cover, Babulal.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: If the cover tears, I will record who ordered this.
lines.spoken: If the cover tears, I will record who ordered this.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Record my designation correctly.
lines.spoken: Record my designation correctly.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: Yesterday she was locked outside her house. Today her death certificate gets a police chair.
lines.spoken: Yesterday, she was locked outside her house. Today, her death certificate gets a police chair.

lines.speaker: SECOND VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: Paper has always received more respect than women here.
lines.spoken: Paper has always received more respect than women here.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: This is supposed to be evidence, not entertainment.
lines.spoken: This is supposed to be evidence, not entertainment.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Correct. That is why you will not interrupt each item.
lines.spoken: Correct. That is why you will not interrupt each item.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One hour earlier, a sealed fingerprint envelope had fallen through the station slot into an empty records room. Nobody saw it arrive.
lines.spoken: One hour earlier, a sealed fingerprint envelope had fallen through the station slot into an empty records room. Nobody saw it arrive.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Now Kavita placed that envelope beside the certificate recording Meera as dead.
lines.sfx_cue: paper envelope placed on wooden table
lines.spoken: Now, Kavita placed that envelope beside the certificate recording Meera as dead.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The open verification has five parts. Documents. Fingerprints. Family testimony. Physical identifiers. Contradictory records.
lines.spoken: The open verification has five parts. Documents. Fingerprints. Family testimony. Physical identifiers. Contradictory records.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: And no final declaration until every objection is entered.
lines.spoken: And no final declaration until every objection is entered.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Agreed. Read the first document.
lines.spoken: Agreed. Read the first document.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: School admission register. Student name, Meera. Father's name, Devraj. Original left-thumb impression attached.
lines.spoken: School admission register. Student name: Meera. Father's name: Devraj. Original left-thumb impression attached.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: That register is old. Ink spreads.
lines.spoken: That register is old. Ink spreads.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Your objection is noted before the result has even been opened.
lines.spoken: Your objection is noted — before the result has even been opened.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: He is frightened.
lines.spoken: He is frightened.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I am frightened of another mistake being made in public.
lines.spoken: I am frightened of another mistake being made in public.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: The first mistake was made in public too. You called a burned body your daughter, then called your living daughter a stranger.
lines.spoken: The first mistake was made in public too. You called a burned body your daughter — then called your living daughter a stranger.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: She has spoken the truth plainly.
lines.spoken: She has spoken the truth plainly.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You saw no face in that hospital either.
lines.spoken: You saw no face in that hospital either.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I was not asked to identify the body.
lines.spoken: I was not asked to identify the body.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Enough. Babulal, the second document.
lines.spoken: Enough. Babulal, the second document.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Ration-card amendment form. Signed by Meera. Right-thumb impression taken two years before her disappearance.
lines.spoken: Ration-card amendment form. Signed by Meera. Right-thumb impression taken two years before her disappearance.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The forensic unit compared both archived impressions with the fresh prints taken at the station.
lines.spoken: The forensic unit compared both archived impressions with the fresh prints taken at the station.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Was the unit told what result the police expected?
lines.spoken: Was the unit told what result the police expected?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The samples were coded. The examiner received no names.
lines.spoken: The samples were coded. The examiner received no names.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: What does the envelope say?
lines.spoken: What does the envelope say?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: You may come closer, Tara. Do not cross the rope.
lines.spoken: You may come closer, Tara. Do not cross the rope.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I can hear from here.
lines.spoken: I can hear from here.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The fresh left-thumb impression matches the school register impression at fourteen corresponding ridge characteristics.
lines.spoken: The fresh left-thumb impression matches the school register impression — at fourteen corresponding ridge characteristics.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: Fourteen points. Say what that means.
lines.spoken: Fourteen points. Say what that means.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: It means the old and new left-thumb impressions were made by the same person.
lines.spoken: It means the old and new left-thumb impressions were made by the same person.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: Ma's thumb remembers her, even if Nana does not.
lines.spoken: Ma's thumb remembers her… even if Nana does not.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: A child should not humiliate his grandfather before a crowd.
lines.spoken: A child should not humiliate his grandfather before a crowd.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: You humiliated Ma before a bigger crowd.
lines.spoken: You humiliated Ma before a bigger crowd.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Mohan, sit down.
lines.spoken: Mohan. Sit down.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: I am sitting.
lines.spoken: I am sitting.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then sit quietly.
lines.spoken: Then sit quietly.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: All right, Ma.
lines.spoken: All right, Ma.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The right-thumb impression also matches the ration-card form.
lines.spoken: The right-thumb impression also matches the ration-card form.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Both archived documents existed before the disappearance. Their dates and storage entries are verified.
lines.spoken: Both archived documents existed before the disappearance. Their dates and storage entries are verified.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: What about the Kota ledger? It carries her signature after the cremation.
lines.spoken: What about the Kota ledger? It carries her signature after the cremation.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: That is the contradictory-record section. We will reach it.
lines.spoken: That is the contradictory-record section. We will reach it.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Conveniently last.
lines.spoken: Conveniently last.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Conveniently in the order I announced before you objected.
lines.spoken: Conveniently, in the order I announced before you objected.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Physical identifiers. Meera, show both hands.
lines.spoken: Physical identifiers. Meera, show both hands.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: The tattoo is on my left hand. It has always been on my left hand.
lines.spoken: The tattoo is on my left hand. It has always been on my left hand.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The hospital photograph shows the burned body's tattoo beside the right wrist.
lines.spoken: The hospital photograph shows the burned body's tattoo beside the right wrist.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The photograph number and hospital intake number are legible. There is no reversal in the image.
lines.spoken: The photograph number and hospital intake number are legible. There is no reversal in the image.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The black thread looked identical.
lines.spoken: The black thread looked identical.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: A black wrist thread is not unique. A tattoo on the opposite hand is a material discrepancy.
lines.spoken: A black wrist thread is not unique. A tattoo on the opposite hand is a material discrepancy.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You did not touch the body, Baba. You would not even touch my hand at the station.
lines.spoken: You did not touch the body, Baba. You would not even touch my hand at the station.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The body was burned. I was told not to disturb it.
lines.spoken: The body was burned. I was told not to disturb it.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Who told you?
lines.spoken: Who told you?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: A hospital worker. I don't... there were several people speaking at once.
lines.spoken: A hospital worker. I don't… there were several people speaking at once.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Name or description?
lines.spoken: Name or description?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: No.
lines.spoken: No.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Then your statement remains that an unidentified worker discouraged a physical check.
lines.spoken: Then your statement remains that an unidentified worker discouraged a physical check.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I was grieving.
lines.spoken: I was grieving.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: And I was alive.
lines.spoken: And I was alive.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Family testimony. Tara, what did Meera know inside the house?
lines.spoken: Family testimony. Tara, what did Meera know inside the house?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: She knew where my first school ribbon was hidden.
lines.spoken: She knew where my first school ribbon was hidden.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Someone could have told her.
lines.spoken: Someone could have told her.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I did not tell anyone the tin was behind the loose brick.
lines.spoken: I did not tell anyone the tin was behind the loose brick.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Did she find it without directions?
lines.spoken: Did she find it without directions?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: Yes.
lines.spoken: Yes.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Do you recognise her as your mother?
lines.spoken: Do you recognise her as your mother?

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: I recognise things she knows. I am not ready to say more.
lines.spoken: I recognise things she knows. I am not ready to say more.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: She does not have to say more today.
lines.spoken: She does not have to say more today.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Mohan?
lines.spoken: Mohan?

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: She sang the sweater song. Only Ma knew the fourth head kisses both her cheeks.
lines.spoken: She sang the sweater song. Only Ma knew the fourth head kisses both her cheeks.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Did she prompt you?
lines.spoken: Did she prompt you?

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: No. I tested her, and she finished it.
lines.spoken: No. I tested her, and she finished it.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: He called her Ma in Kota. We all heard about it.
lines.spoken: He called her Ma in Kota. We all heard about it.

lines.speaker: mohan
lines.text: I will call her Ma here too. Ma. Ma. Ma.
lines.spoken: I will call her Ma here too. Ma! Ma! Ma!

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The repetition is unnecessary, but the answer is recorded.
lines.spoken: The repetition is unnecessary, but the answer is recorded.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Let him repeat it. They repeated that I was dead for eighteen months.
lines.spoken: Let him repeat it. They repeated that I was dead for eighteen months.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Now the Kota rental ledger.
lines.spoken: Now, the Kota rental ledger.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The tenant name is Sarla. The signature appears to say Meera. The date is the twenty-first of June, twenty twenty-one.
lines.spoken: The tenant name is Sarla. The signature appears to say Meera. The date is the twenty-first of June, twenty twenty-one.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Meera provided six fresh signatures under observation this morning.
lines.spoken: Meera provided six fresh signatures under observation this morning.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: A person can alter a signature.
lines.spoken: A person can alter a signature.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Yes. That is why the examiner also compared letter formation, pressure and stroke order with older records.
lines.spoken: Yes. That is why the examiner also compared letter formation, pressure, and stroke order with older records.

lines.speaker: tara
lines.text: And?
lines.spoken: And?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The Kota signature appears copied. Its strokes stop and restart where Meera's natural signature remains continuous.
lines.spoken: The Kota signature appears copied. Its strokes stop and restart where Meera's natural signature remains continuous.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Someone signed my name.
lines.spoken: Someone signed my name.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: That is the present forensic opinion. The ledger does not disprove your identity.
lines.spoken: That is the present forensic opinion. The ledger does not disprove your identity.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Opinion is not certainty.
lines.spoken: Opinion is not certainty.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Neither was your identification of the body, yet it was accepted as certainty.
lines.spoken: Neither was your identification of the body — yet it was accepted as certainty.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Madam, the register cannot simply be rewritten during a village meeting.
lines.spoken: Madam, the register cannot simply be rewritten during a village meeting.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: I am not ordering a rewrite. I am ordering the death certificate marked disputed pending formal correction and further inquiry.
lines.spoken: I am not ordering a rewrite. I am ordering the death certificate marked disputed, pending formal correction and further inquiry.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: That requires recorded grounds.
lines.spoken: That requires recorded grounds.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Record them. Two fingerprint matches. Correct private family knowledge. A physical tattoo discrepancy. A copied rental signature. Consistent identification of the Kota room.
lines.spoken: Record them. Two fingerprint matches. Correct private family knowledge. A physical tattoo discrepancy. A copied rental signature. Consistent identification of the Kota room.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You are declaring her genuine because the crowd wants a miracle.
lines.spoken: You are declaring her genuine because the crowd wants a miracle.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: No. I am announcing that the evidence strongly supports Meera being alive and genuine.
lines.spoken: No. I am announcing that the evidence strongly supports Meera being alive and genuine.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: Say it again. Let the people at the back hear.
lines.spoken: Say it again! Let the people at the back hear.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The woman standing here is strongly supported by documentary, fingerprint and family evidence as Meera.
lines.spoken: The woman standing here is strongly supported by documentary, fingerprint, and family evidence as Meera.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Babulal, bring me the paper that buried my name.
lines.spoken: Babulal… bring me the paper that buried my name.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: It remains government property.
lines.spoken: It remains government property.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then let the government correct itself where everyone can see.
lines.spoken: Then let the government correct itself — where everyone can see.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: I have a red disputed-record seal. Once stamped, the certificate cannot be used as an uncontested proof of death.
lines.spoken: I have a red disputed-record seal. Once stamped, the certificate cannot be used as an uncontested proof of death.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Apply it.
lines.spoken: Apply it.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Wait. If you stamp that, the original murder case—
lines.spoken: Wait! If you stamp that, the original murder case—

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Will be reviewed on evidence. Not protected from embarrassment.
lines.spoken: Will be reviewed on evidence. Not protected from embarrassment.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The seal is inked.
lines.spoken: The seal is inked.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Do it.
lines.spoken: Do it.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: The police officially acknowledge that the original identification of the burned body may have been wrong.
lines.spoken: The police officially acknowledge that the original identification of the burned body may have been wrong.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Meera's death certificate is now sealed and formally marked disputed.
lines.spoken: Meera's death certificate is now sealed — and formally marked disputed.
